title: Unused Mutability
pattern: Declaring a local variable as mutable (`mut`) when it is never reassigned or modified.
why_bad: Indicates that the variable was intended to change but didn't, or represents a leftover design, cluttering code analysis.
detection: Variables declared with `mut` that are never targeted by assignment or mutable borrow operations.
counterexample: Required by specific library API interfaces or macros.
fix: Remove the `mut` keyword from the variable declaration.
